componentPolicy.platform: desktop only; use BottomSheet on mobile-web
componentPolicy.requiredAnatomy: Title, Subtitle, Close and at least one visible Button
componentPolicy.tail: Tail Direction and Tail Position are component properties; the tail must point to the target object or area
componentPolicy.steps: Pips are hidden for one step; multi-step onboarding requires non-interactive Pips on every step, count matches steps and exactly one Pip is selected
componentPolicy.buttons: one or two Size=40 Rectangular buttons without addons; SingleIcon and DisabledState are false; Primary required, Secondary optional
componentPolicy.stepButtons: single and first step: Primary; intermediate: Secondary previous and Primary next; last: Primary finish
componentPolicy.contentLimits: warning over Subhead 20, Title 30, Subtitle 90 or Button label 10 characters
componentPolicy.close: required and fixed; closes current onboarding without confirmation
componentPolicy.target: target object or area must remain visible; it may remain interactive
componentPolicy.content: plain text only; links, lists and rich text are forbidden
componentPolicy.placement: must fit the viewport; resolve insufficient space through Tail Direction or Tail Position
componentPolicy.states: default only; loading, disabled, error and interrupted are unsupported
componentPolicy.interaction: outside interface is blocked; target object may remain interactive and may advance or finish the scenario
componentPolicy.visibility: only one Onboarding Tooltip is visible; next step replaces previous
componentPolicy.dismiss: Close or final Primary action only; Escape and outside click do not dismiss
componentPolicy.textOverflow: Subhead single-line ellipsis; Title and Subtitle wrap without truncation; Button label single-line
componentPolicy.overlay: blocking overlay with highlighted target area is required
componentPolicy.temporarySurfaces: Modal and Drawer are allowed when the target is inside
componentPolicy.targetPreconditions: target exists, is visible and is inside the viewport before launch
componentPolicy.flowOwnership: step order, cross-page navigation, repeat launch and skip are business logic
componentPolicy.visualBaseline: width, padding, spacing, radius, fill, typography, opacity and effects are fixed; height is Hug by content
componentPolicy.baseline: Use the effective baseline after Tail Direction and Tail Position resolution.
